purpose: Design of the indexing pipeline: fixing the target set, confirming and assigning DLIDs, detecting changes, generating needed info, and publishing the ToC atomically.
summary: Inputs, outputs and execution boundary of a ToC build, including the rule that the build never rewrites index target documents
Target resolution: argument combination rules, directory and pattern expansion, exclusions, fixed excluded directories, path normalization, symlinks, and Markdown detection
DLID confirmation: reading doc_link_id from frontmatter, excluding documents with missing or duplicate IDs from the confirmed target list while continuing the build

DLID assignment operation: explicitly invoked, writes only DLIDs (document and section IDs), duplicate original resolution with the user, 60-bit Crockford Base32 issuance, and per-document rollback on non-DLID diffs
Change set determination: new, left target, path change, content hash change, and reference or physical path change, recorded independently per document
Section-level change detection by section ID: added, removed, moved, heading changed, and body changed
Move detection via a per-key record file that accumulates document ID, old path and new path across advance steps
Information acquisition and candidate finalization: reuse of document info, AI generation only where needed, candidate checks, and one-shot publishing of the confirmed ToC
Completion output contract: counts and key items on stdout, full details in a detail file published by a single replacement
Write units, atomic replacement via os.replace, no locking, and failure and re-run behavior
tasks: Implementing or modifying the index-docs build script
Implementing or modifying the DLID assignment operation
Designing target resolution arguments and exclusion rules
Implementing change set and section-level change detection
Implementing move detection and its record file
Reviewing how the build output and detail file are structured
Investigating build failures and re-run behavior
Reviewing consistency between the requirements and the indexing design
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
